scope: Exact immutable warm-operator publication, current queue/source/document pins, scientific-review artifact bindings, saved-input restore mapping and finalized shared Git operation. No lifecycle replay or model computation duplicated.

checks.current_pointers: both reference exact reviewed packet and manifest
checks.queue: One completed warm record; exact prior partial preserved in history; stale current partial links removed; new blend-contract candidate not_started with unevaluated evidence; unrelated entries and operational gate unchanged.
checks.artifact_binding: Independent accepted source review, packet review, run identity, recipe, checkpoint and actual portable receipt agree exactly.
checks.portable_receipt: 44 scientific payloads equal; 14 relocated tests passed with zero skips, per independently recorded fresh replay; this publication reviewer did not replay again.
checks.restore_handoff: Actual CLI arguments, companion location/hash, exact recipe/paths, fresh destination and isolated rollback checked against source and existing files; local-to-package mapping retained.
checks.git: Clean source commit and receipt agree; local bundle and operation manifest/member hashes verified; remote same-commit operation is root's recorded evidence, not a repeated network check.
checks.preflight: Root executing current final preflight separately; no claim that this reviewer reran it. Bind its completed receipt in final operation.

limitations: Acceptance establishes publication and exact artifact integrity, not forecast improvement or policy merit.
No model fitted, loaded or recomputed during publication review.
Local readback does not verify OneDrive or a second machine.
Full-project engineering readiness and trading authorization remain separate and ungranted.
